codeReview.summary: Clean extraction of light culling state from VulkanRenderer into a self-contained LightSubsystem struct. The implementation follows the established ShadowSubsystem pattern with init(), destroy(), and resize() lifecycle methods. LightInitContext provides dependency injection for VulkanRenderer-owned resources (context, material_compiler). Thin delegation methods on VulkanRenderer preserve the public API. Material recompilation on resize correctly remains in the VulkanRenderer delegation layer since it's a cross-cutting concern. All fields on LightSubsystem are properly private. The old LightCullingState type name is fully removed with no stale references remaining.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The subsystem extraction pattern (LightInitContext for dependency injection, thin delegation wrappers on VulkanRenderer, private fields on subsystem) is now used by ShadowSubsystem and LightSubsystem but not documented in .factory/library/. This pattern is relevant to other pending extraction features (outline, depth-prepass, picking).
